title: Squeezing Neoclouds Pushes NVIDIA Back Toward Its Rivals
summary: NVIDIA's $107.6b Q3 Data Center business faces a strategic dilemma : hyperscalers ($60.1b) are building custom ASICs to replace NVIDIA GPUs, while neoclouds & frontier labs ($47.5b) build no competing chips but need NVIDIA's balance sheet. After peaking at 45.3% in Q2, neocloud share dipped to 44.1% in Q3 as NVIDIA tightened financing terms.

title: The Lakehouse for AI
summary: LanceDB raised a $57.5m Series B ($98.5m total) after growing revenue >10x YoY & open-source downloads 6x to 120m+. Across Exa, Runway, Microsoft AI, Adobe & NVIDIA, teams are replacing fragmented blob, Parquet & vector copies with a single multimodal lakehouse supporting 100b rows, 40b+ vectors & 8k+ GPUs training in parallel.
